title: 18.20. Āsavavippayuttasāsavaduka, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Āsavavippayuttaṁ sāsavaṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ.
Āsavavippayuttaṁ anāsavaṁ hetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe dve …pe… avigate cattāri.

Āsavavippayuttaṁ sāsavaṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Āsavavippayuttaṁ anāsavaṁ nahetuṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca āsavavippayutto nasāsavo nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
